text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite several periods of little change and a temporary decline; I should judge decisions over time, not by one month's result.","Selling Stock D in stages locked in some gains, but a large gain versus my average cost alone does not determine whether to sell; I should reassess its prospects and portfolio role objectively.","Frequent account checks can tempt me to trade on noise, so I should make deliberate decisions using current information rather than reacting to random price movements."]}
